UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information for the authenticated building owner

id.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

BuildingData.title: BuildingData
BuildingData.description: Comprehensive building data including settings, apartments list, and cycles

id.description: Unique identifier of the building record matching owner userId

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

settings.description: Building settings including name, owner phone, currency, and rates

apartments.description: List of apartments in the building

cycles.description: List of monthly billing and accounting cycles

activeCycleId.description: ID of the currently active cycle

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last save

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private user profile details for each authenticated owner

/buildings/{userId}.description: Stores all building data, apartments, accounting cycles, and meter records owned by the user
